## Context / Problem
`infra/scripts/container-cap.sh` was added after the original comment-remediation inventory and contains repeated incident history, duplicated mechanism explanations, and obvious narration. Audit basis is `origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`.

## Approach
Condense only ordinary shell-comment blocks identified by stable code anchors. Preserve shell behavior, embedded programs, rendered unit-file text, operator-facing diagnostics, and directives byte-for-byte.

The content guard compares immutable before/final blobs after removing only the explicit allowlisted shell-comment spans from each. It rejects changes outside those spans. It separately preserves the shebang and SC2086 directive with their next executable statements. Every heredoc body remains exact: comments inside the rendered systemd units and embedded Python are runtime content, not editable shell comments.

## Scope
- File header before `set -uo pipefail` — retain the shared writable-layer budget, XFS `pquota`/reboot constraint, per-container/create-time limitation, reaper limits, three protected sets, bounded-debris formula, and side-effect-free mode contract; remove outage chronology and repeated emphasis.
- Share/policy declarations through `REAPER_UNIT` — retain single sourcing from `docker-storage-cap.sh`, no guessed fallback, grace window, label/name/running protections, quota filesystem, nested timer/unit bounds, and Docker-call bound.
- Validation and `_docker` blocks — retain fail-loud numeric validation and the no-`timeout` degradation.
- Shell prose around `render_*`, `write_units`, `reaper_in_effect`, and `quota_enforced` — retain exact rendered-unit ownership, timer/content checks, and fail-closed quota enforcement. Do not change heredoc bytes.
- Shell prose around `census_format`, `census`, and `protected` — retain one `SizeRw` census, dynamically derived label columns, absent-label normalization, and independent protections.
- Shell prose inside `reap` — retain unreadable-share/census refusal, six-field `read`, running/protected/grace handling, oldest-first target, no-force/no-volume removal, and loud residual-over-budget limits.
- Shell prose before `finished_epoch` — retain portable Python parsing and never-started timestamp semantics. Preserve the entire embedded Python heredoc exactly.
- `report_state`, argument handling, `--print-env`, and install prose — retain strongest-supported regime reporting, single-quoted eval-safe values, installed-copy fallback, timer enablement, and final status.

Consumers include `compose-up.sh`, `observability.sh`, `docker-storage-cap.sh`, the operations runbook, Terraform alarm guidance, and the container-cap/storage/observability tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The one-commit changed-path set is exactly the 1-path file-impact set.
- [x] Only the allowlisted ordinary shell-comment spans and adjacent blank lines change.
- [x] Every executable shell line remains byte-identical.
- [x] Every heredoc body remains byte-identical.
- [x] Every operator-facing output string remains byte-identical.
- [x] The shebang remains byte-identical.
- [x] The SC2086 directive line remains byte-identical.
- [x] The SC2086 directive remains attached to the same executable statement.
- [x] Every edited block has fewer words than its immutable-base version.
- [x] Every edited block has a non-author TSV row with immutable before/final citations.
- [x] Every TSV row identifies the preserved constraint or consumer.
- [x] Every TSV row records its before and after word counts.
- [x] Every TSV row records `semantic-preservation=PASS`.
- [x] Every TSV row records `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [x] Every recorded focused test exits 0 at the leaf commit.
- [x] The recorded ShellCheck-policy command exits 0 at the leaf commit.
- [x] The recorded path-scoped `git diff --check` exits 0 at the leaf commit.
- [x] The Gerrit Verified gate passes at the exact reviewed revision.

## Verification
Run the recorded allowlist/executable/heredoc/directive comparator; `tests/scripts/test_container_cap.py`, `tests/scripts/test_observability_container_layers.py`, and `tests/scripts/test_docker_storage_cap.py`; `scripts/check_shellcheck.py`; path-scoped `git diff --check`; Gerrit CI passes. The independent TSV is authoritative for prose quality.
